contentHtml:
Without a doubt, your business is successful and caters to its customers’ needs efficiently. But it is always a good idea to invest in a good digital marketing agency to remove bad links pointing to your website. It takes years to build a good reputation but a single negative review is enough to sabotage it. Hence, it is advisable to approach an experienced bad links removal agency and have your negative links removed.

Why should you remove negative links?

As mentioned, it takes ages to build a good reputation online but negative reviews and links can easily bring it down. Believe it or not, there are several fake accounts created every day simply to sabotage a business with derogatory comments. It is always advisable to delete these accounts and their comments at the earliest before your audience sees them.

This way, you can ensure that your audience’s first impression of your brand is positive and untainted by negative comments. This way, you will notice that the quality of your audience will shift from the mainstream of uninterested people to people who genuinely require your products. When you invest in a bad links removal agency, which platforms should you be aware of?

Which platforms should you be aware of?

Social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter are the main sources of negative comments. If you are maintaining a profile on these platforms, be aware of how your content is being received by your followers. Hide negative comments if required or respond to them quickly and constructively.

Comments on Quora, Reddit, and social forums are also a major source of derogatory reviews and links. Negative backlinks on web pages and sites, or pages that have guest posts mentioning you also need to be monitored. Complaints on the Consumer Complaints Board, testimonials on your website, and negative content on GMB profiles need to be checked frequently.

Which strategies work?

It makes no sense to invest in unauthentic or artificial backlink generators. Google penalizes such links and automated backlink generators can get your website in trouble. If your website is free of spam links and has all its negative links removed, you have a higher chance of ranking well on Google. It works to create positive links and make guest posts on authentic sites to generate positive backlinks to improve your rankings.

Creating Disavow links files to indicate to Google that you no longer wish to display these links also works. It is a good way to remove bad links, as you are telling Google you don’t need these links anymore. But be sure to add positive links after removing these negative links to ensure your rankings remain high. This can be done by curating content specific to your niche and promoting it with the right keywords and phrases that are popularly searched.
